title: Grey and ductile iron grades: EN, ASTM and IS
intro: Specify the grade in the standard you use. The table shows the approximate equivalents we work with.

rows.use: End shields, pump casings, agricultural parts

disclaimer: Approximate equivalent; final grade per customer drawing and specification.

sections.title: Specifying a grade
paragraphs: Put the grade on your drawing in the standard you normally use: EN, ASTM or IS. In our quotation we confirm the grade we will cast to and how it will be tested.

Equivalents between standards are approximate because test bar sizes, minimum values and chemistry limits differ. If your part has critical properties (pressure rating, hardness range, elongation), list them on the drawing or in the RFQ.
